scope: local real-host Figma plugin full-flow verification

realHostObservations.observation: Figma+EX loaded the local testing manifest and rendered the verified main PNG for studio-display-front without the previous asset-service error. The portable SHA-256 fallback preserved the existing integrity comparison in the null-origin plugin iframe.
The selected Figma RECTANGLE named image 2 was read as a 2048 x 1454 source and composited into the selected mockup.

Scale advanced from 100% to 101%; horizontal advanced from 0% to 1%; vertical changed from 0% to -1%; rotation advanced from 0 degrees to 1 degree. Values and rendered source transform changed without resizing the physical aperture.
Dragging the top-left perspective handle changed the projected quadrilateral and the UI state changed from default perspective to adjusted.
Switching from studio-display-front to rock-phone-front retained the imported design and produced a complete phone mockup; export and paste remained enabled.
The plugin created and selected a 1200 x 900 Figma image node named 岩石手机 · 正面 · 样机工作室 at node 335:9.
The plugin exported a real 1448 x 1086 RGB PNG. Visual inspection confirmed the imported design is composited inside the complete zero-green-screen phone mockup.

rootCauseCorrections.problem: Verified main assets failed only inside the real Figma plugin iframe.
rootCauseCorrections.rootCause: The null-origin Figma iframe did not expose SubtleCrypto, while the integrity verifier assumed crypto.subtle was always available.
rootCauseCorrections.correction: Use WebCrypto when available and a tested portable SHA-256 implementation otherwise; do not bypass or weaken the digest check.

rootCauseCorrections.problem: Scale and position sliders appeared available but were clamped back to their defaults.
rootCauseCorrections.rootCause: The controls transformed the visible content aperture and then constrained that aperture to itself, making scale above 100% and movement at the default full-frame state impossible.
rootCauseCorrections.correction: Keep the physical content aperture fixed and transform the covered source image independently; derive UI values from that same canonical source frame.

boundaries.claim: This evidence proves a local real-host engineering and functional pass for the named build. It does not prove public release readiness, external hosting, marketplace approval, product success, or final human acceptance.
